name: dotnet-upgrade
description: 'Prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution'

Prompts:
- Identify and classify all solution projects (`.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, `.NET Standard`); analyze each `.csproj` `TargetFramework` and SDK usage.
- Review dependency compatibility, graph depth, legacy `packages.config` migration to `PackageReference`, transitive conflicts, and shared dependency strategies.
- Recommend least-to-most-dependent ordering; isolate class libraries before API or Azure Function migrations.
- Plan incremental upgrades with rollback checkpoints; evaluate **Upgrade Assistant** versus **manual upgrades**.
- Generate build/test/deployment checklists; suggest `TargetFramework` (e.g., `net8.0`) and update deprecated SDK/build configurations.
- Identify modernization needs (`WebHostBuilder` → `HostBuilder`), deprecated APIs/libraries, synchronous-to-async conversions, and package versions/migration paths for libraries lacking .NET 8 support.
- Analyze YAML SDK pinning; update `UseDotNet@2` and `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 pipeline snippets, feature-branch validation builds, and CI test/build automation.
- Validate builds/runs; execute unit/integration tests; verify logging, telemetry, connectivity, backward compatibility, and runtime behavior.
- Recommend UAT and comprehensive pre-production scenarios.
- Use `.NET Upgrade Assistant` and API Analyzer; recommend API replacements and `Startup.cs` → `Program.cs` refactoring.
- Create critical endpoint/service regression plans.
- Recomme

name: dotnet-upgrade
description: 'Prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution'

Prompts:
- Identify and classify all solution projects (`.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, `.NET Standard`); analyze each `.csproj` `TargetFramework` and SDK usage.
- Review dependency compatibility, graph depth, legacy `packages.config` migration to `PackageReference`, transitive conflicts, and shared dependency strategies.
- Recommend least-to-most-dependent ordering; isolate class libraries before API or Azure Function migrations.
- Plan incremental upgrades with rollback checkpoints; evaluate **Upgrade Assistant** versus **manual upgrades**.
- Generate build/test/deployment checklists; suggest `TargetFramework` (e.g., `net8.0`) and update deprecated SDK/build configurations.
- Identify modernization needs (`WebHostBuilder` → `HostBuilder`), deprecated APIs/libraries, synchronous-to-async conversions, and package versions/migration paths for libraries lacking .NET 8 support.
- Analyze YAML SDK pinning; update `UseDotNet@2` and `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 pipeline snippets, feature-branch validation builds, and CI test/build automation.
- Validate builds/runs; execute unit/integration tests; verify logging, telemetry, connectivity, backward compatibility, and runtime behavior.
- Recommend UAT and comprehensive pre-production scenarios.
- Use `.NET Upgrade Assistant` and API Analyzer; recommend API replacements and `Startup.cs` → `Program.cs` refactoring.
- Create critical endpoint/service regression plans.
- Recommend rollback-capable branching, commit templates, structured PRs (`Upgrade to .NET [Version]`), breaking-change tags, and build/test/dependency review checklists.
- Document framework changes.
